profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Building Scalable Microservices, AI-Ready Systems & Agentic Workflows | Angular, .NET Core, AWS
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience designing, developing, and delivering scalable, high-performance software solutions across technology, automotive, finance, staffing, and enterprise SaaS environments. I specialize in microservices architecture, cloud-native systems, Angular front-end applications, and back-end services using .NET Core, C#, Python, REST APIs, SQL Server, and AWS.

My recent focus includes AI-enabled software development and agentic automation, including AI agents, workflow orchestration, LLM integration, tool/function calling, retrieval-augmented generation, feedback loops, human-in-the-loop processes, and sub-agent collaboration. I am passionate about building intelligent systems that can interact with APIs, automate multi-step workflows, reason over business data, and support enterprise decision-making.

At Avionte, I led development efforts for complex marketplace communication integrations, supporting over 100,000 daily active users with 99.95% uptime. I designed and deployed multi-tier applications and AWS-based microservices that improved performance and reduced server response times by 40%.

At BMW America, I helped redesign a Workforce Management system using microservices architecture, improving system reliability by 30% and reducing downtime by 25%. I also integrated machine learning models into finance workflows, improving data processing efficiency by 40%.

At Dell Technologies, I strengthened software quality through Test-Driven Development, increasing code coverage from 50% to 90% and reducing production defects by approximately 25%. I also implemented a data center configuration function supporting over 2 billion combination options, improving validation, data management, and retrieval performance.

I bring strong experience in system design, API development, event-driven architecture, cloud deployment, automated testing, performance optimization, AI workflow automation, and engineering leadership. I hold a Master of Science in Computer Science and continue to stay current with modern software engineering, AI agents, LLM applications, and enterprise architecture trends.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
🔹 Led the design and delivery of scalable marketplace communication systems, improving operational efficiency through API-driven automation, workflow orchestration, and service integration.

🔹 Managed a team of three developers to deliver complex marketplace integrations, enabling reliable partner data exchange and seamless business operations.

🔹 Architected highly available distributed systems supporting 100,000+ daily active users with 99.95% uptime.

🔹 Built workflow-driven backend services with validation, retry logic, monitoring, feedback loops, and event-based processing to reduce manual operations.

🔹 Leveraged Claude Code and agentic AI coding workflows to accelerate development, refactoring, debugging, test generation, and code review preparation.

🔹 Applied AI-assisted engineering practices using agentic loops, context-aware prompts, subagent-style task decomposition, and human-in-the-loop validation.

🔹 Designed AI-ready application architecture with clean APIs, structured data flows, reusable services, and integration layers for future LLM, MCP, and tool-calling use cases.

🔹 Developed modern Angular 15 micro front-end applications, improving user experience and supporting modular product growth.

🔹 Applied Test-Driven Development to achieve 90%+ code coverage and reduce production defects.

🔹 Engineered multi-tier applications using .NET, SQL, REST APIs, Angular, AWS, and microservices, reducing server response times by 40%.

🔹 Improved delivery velocity through CI/CD, automated testing, daily deployments, and AI-enhanced development workflows.
